WITH execution_counts AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
total_executions AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM orderexecutions
),
shares AS (
  SELECT ec.ordersmark, ec.exec_count,
    CAST(ec.exec_count AS REAL) / te.total_count as share
  FROM execution_counts ec, total_executions te
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value
  FROM shares
),
with_differences AS (
  SELECT s.ordersmark, s.exec_count, s.share,
    s.share - a.avg_share_value as share_diff
  FROM shares s, avg_share_calc a
)
SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share_diff
FROM with_differences
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ordersmark IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share_diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
